note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The two witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: Both witnesses print a bare initial: the typical edition drops the acute on a CAPITAL, which is typography and not a claim about the word. The same leaf sets éxcita lowercase and accented in the Advent III gradual. The accent is restored, as on every other capitalised word in this edition (checks/capitals.py).
House orthography prints consonantal i, as the typical edition does.
The typical edition sets no comma after ut. The witness's comma is its own pointing.
